title: SS28 Toddler Girls' Knit Fabric Direction
summary: SS28 kidswear knits: organic jersey, UPF swim and cooling jerseys.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime) take place in June 2027. This report projects from SS28 adult previews, the SS27 kidswear fair record and long-term drivers such as heat and UV protection, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- UV-protective, breathable and quick-dry kidswear became common at Pitti Bimbo in June 2026<sup>[1]</sup>
- SS27 kidswear fairs showed swim with UV protection, organic cotton and coordinated sets<sup>[2]</sup>
- Everyday basics gain "integrated wellness properties" and materials that "intuitively adjust for temperature and activity"<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Fabric by fabric
sections.body:
| Knit | Hand | Uses |
|---|---|---|
| Organic jersey | Soft | Tees |
| UPF swim | Stretch | Swim |
| Cooling jersey | Fresh | Sets |
| Cotton crochet | Handmade | Tops |

design_implications:
- Test pilling, stretch recovery and colour fastness.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
